name: freelancer-competitions-mcp
description: Freelancer (competitions): me, discover, get_competition. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_freelancer_access_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_FREELANCER_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_freelancer_access_token.description: OAuth access token with the `basic` scope (a personal access token from https://accounts.freelancer.com/settings/develop works); sent in the freelancer-oauth-v1 header.

tools.name: discover
tools.description: GET /contests/0.1/contests/active/ (query = space-separated terms matched against names and descriptions; limit/offset): active contests only, so `status` is not sent. `kind` is the contest type (e.g. guaranteed). prize (number) with currency, time_ended (Unix seconds), seo_url and jobs stay in `raw`.

tools.name: get_competition
tools.description: GET /contests/0.1/contests/{contest_id}/ (numeric id); the API answers {result: {contests: [contest]}}, and an unknown id is an empty list (invalid_input). prize, currency, time_ended and judging_period_days stay in `raw`.
